pr_title: [CI] Move accuracy-group-2 to weekly single node configs

correspondence.review_quote: zhangxinyuehfad 指出该 weekly 工作流的 artifact 名称仍为 `nightly-a2`，应参照 `Weekly-A3` 命名改为 `weekly-a2`，使产物名与执行周期一致。作者将 `name` 改为 `weekly-a2`，作者回复 "Modified"。

rule.description: 将测试用例从 nightly 迁移到 weekly 工作流后，上传 artifact 的 `name` 前缀须同步从 `nightly-*` 改为 `weekly-*`，与同类 weekly 工作流（如 Weekly-A3）命名保持一致，便于按周期归档与检索。
checkpoints: 检查用例在 nightly/weekly 工作流间迁移后，artifact `name` 前缀是否同步更新
weekly 工作流产物不应残留 `nightly-` 前缀
同周期同类工作流命名风格应统一（如 `weekly-a2` 对齐 `weekly-a3`）

antipattern.code:
upload-benchmark-results:
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Download all benchmark artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          pattern: nightly-test-benchmark-results-*
          merge-multiple: true
          path: ./benchmark-results

      - name: Upload merged benchmark results
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: actions/upload-artifact/merge@v7
        with:
          name: nightly-a2
          pattern: nightly-test-benchmark-results-*
          compression-level: 0
          delete-merged: true
